motions.text: That the May 14, 2024 Council Consent items identified below be adopted.
motions.text_html: 1. That the May 14, 2024 Council Consent items identified below be adopted.

motions.item_title: 2187 Gordon Street - Intention to Demolish a Cultural Heritage Resource, 2024-221
motions.text: That the application of intention to demolish the cultural heritage resources at 2187 Gordon Street be refused as the property has been protected by heritage designation By-law (2024)-20901 through the provisions of Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act.
motions.text_html: 1. That the application of intention to demolish the cultural heritage resources at 2187 Gordon Street be refused as the property has been protected by heritage designation By-law (2024)-20901 through the provisions of Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act.

motions.item_title: 9 Omar Street – Removal from Municipal Register of Cultural Heritage Properties and Notice of Intention to Demolish, 2024-225
motions.text: That the property known as 9 Omar Street be removed from the Municipal Register of Cultural Heritage Properties, and; That the demolition of dwelling at 9 Omar Street be approved.
motions.text_html:
1. That the property known as 9 Omar Street be removed from the Municipal Register of Cultural Heritage Properties, and;
  2. That the demolition of dwelling at 9 Omar Street be approved.

motions.text: That by-laws (2024)-20909, (2024)-20921, (2024)-20941 and (2024)-20942 be approved, as amended, subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
